summary: Tested Venture Path gamification (backend endpoint + frontend page + nav link). 7/7 pytest cases passed; frontend renders correctly with seeded student session. Nav link on student dashboard navigates to /venture-path. All 6 module cards render with correct testids; Module 2 shows unlocked with best score 85; summary shows '1 / 6'; trend chart renders when scored submission exists.

issues: Recharts logs harmless width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render before container measures (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7923 lines — should be split into routers for maintainability (long-standing issue, not new).

parse_readiness_score clamps to 1..100 which conflicts with the endpoint's implicit convention that best_score=0 means 'not attempted' (attempted = best_score > 0). If a legitimate score of 1 is ever stored, module would still show attempted=True which is correct, but the clamp min=1 means a raw '0' from the AI is coerced to 1. Minor edge case only.
test_credentials: Seeded ephemeral TEST_ student + session in Mongo per test_credentials.md pattern; cleaned up post-test.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST_ prefixed student user, session, cohort, assignment (6 milestones), one submission at week 2 with readiness_score=85. All cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_venture_path.py seeds/cleans its own data. Frontend nav link (data-testid=venture-path-nav-link) is on StudentAssignmentsDashboard header and works. Recharts warning is cosmetic.
